extracted.intended_audience: subscribers and contributors to the Victorian periodical 'Notes and Queries' (antiquarians, genealogists, book-sellers, and general scholarly readers)
extracted.subtask_description: An issue of the mid-19th-century periodical Notes and Queries containing letters, antiquarian notes, book notices, advertisements, and submission/purchase instructions for contributors and booksellers. The page is a single issue intended for readers and potential correspondents or sellers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books and odd volumes wanted — submission requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: 'BOOKS AND ODD VOLUMES WANTED TO PURCHASE. ... Letters, stating particulars and lowest price, carriage free, to be sent to MR. BELL, Publisher of "NOTES AND QUERIES," 186. Fleet Street.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sellers should send letters that state particulars of the books/volumes and the lowest price; postage/carriage to be free; address correspondence to Mr. Bell, Publisher of Notes and Queries at 186 Fleet Street. (This is the procedural requirement for offers to sell books to the publisher.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing communications for the Editor
rubrics_metrics.description: 'All communications for the Editor of NOTES AND QUERIES should be addressed to the care of MR. BELL, No. 186. Fleet Street.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions, letters, and other communications intended for the Editor must be sent to Mr. Bell at the given Fleet Street address. This is the explicit procedural instruction for where to send contributions or queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and distribution notice
rubrics_metrics.description: 'NOTES AND QUERIES may be procured, by order, of all Booksellers and Newsvenders. It is published at noon on Friday, so that our country Subscribers ought not to experience any difficulty in procuring it regularly.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information for purchasers/subscribers: the periodical is available by order from booksellers and newsvendors and is published at a specific weekly time (noon on Friday). The notice also advises country subscribers about expected delivery timing (Saturday parcels) and suggests booksellers may not yet be aware of the arrangement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Erratum / correction notice practice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrections to prior issues are printed in subsequent issues as errata, showing the original erroneous item and the corrected reading. (Indicates the periodical's practice for issuing corrections.)
